description: Show an error-correcting code and certify its distance: its checks (Z-type: they see X errors) and stabilizers (X-type), k counted by rank, a layout to draw it, the decoders it admits, and its distance certificate. In each sector the certificate gives the least weight of a logical found, a witness of that weight, and every lighter support ruled out by an exhaustive search over connected supports (a bivariate-bicycle code's translations checked as symmetries before use), re-checkable node for node. Give `certificate` to check one: its witnesses and the search run again. Sealed with the service's key. Quote the certificate's distance and its reading; a search stopped by `bound` settles nothing past it.

bound.description: The heaviest support to search (default the code's nominal distance).

certificate.description: A certificate (wai.quantum.distance/1) to check against the code.

code.description: A code by name: surface:D (the rotated surface code, odd D from 3 to 15), toric:L (2 to 12), steane, color:D (the triangular 6.6.6 colour code, odd D from 3 to 15), bb:72, bb:90, bb:108, bb:144 (or gross) or bb:288 (bivariate-bicycle codes); or {"family", "distance" | "size" | "n"}.

name: qec_code

anyOf.description: An error-correction answer as every host gives it (engine::qec: qec_code, qec_decode and qec_threshold on both servers, wai-quantum qec, POST /v1/qec/*, the Studio and Python): the request, and the result sealed in a job's form. A code with its distance certificate (or a given certificate checked); a syndrome, an error or a circuit's detectors decoded, or shots sampled and decoded; logical failure rates over distances and physical rates. A result names the engine that made it and this schema (engine and schema). docs/qec.md explains each.
A code: its checks and stabilizers, k, its layout, the decoders it takes, and its distance certificate (or a given one's check).

certificate.description: A code's distance certificate (quantum_distance): in each sector, a witness logical of the least weight found and every lighter support ruled out by an exhaustive search over connected supports, re-checkable node for node; the code's families hash, the search's bound, the symmetries checked and used, and its reading. Given back to qec_code, it is checked against the code.

distance.description: The distance, when both sectors settle it; null when the search stopped at its bound first.

families.description: BLAKE3 of the code's check families, in hex.

x.description: One sector: the least weight of a logical found, a witness of that weight, and the weight below which the search ruled every support out.

z.description: One sector: the least weight of a logical found, a witness of that weight, and the weight below which the search ruled every support out.

certificate.title: wai.quantum.distance/1

check.description: A given certificate's check: its witnesses, and the search run again.

engine.description: The engine that made the result: the wai-quantum crate's name and version.

receipt.description: A result's receipt: an Ed25519 signature, by the key it names, over digest = BLAKE3("wai:quantum-service-receipt\x02" ‖ len ‖ request ‖ len ‖ result), each of request and result in its RFC 8785 canonical text (the result without its receipt member), each length 8 bytes big-endian. Whatever members the request and the result hold are sealed, the result's engine and schema among them. The first receipts (no canon member, $defs/first) signed serde_json's own text under the domain ending \x01; they still verify.

digest.description: The digest signed, 32 bytes in hex.

key.description: The signing key, 32 bytes in hex.
